assembly.joints: Outer frame M3850 head/jambs and sill only under the fixed light; door opening has no sill. Transom M92887 runs across the full width above door and side light (estimated); mullion M92887 between door and side light. Leaf M50166 on all 4 sides with MITRED corners (elevation shows 45° corner lines on the leaf only). Glass held by bead M50165.
assembly.clearances_mm: wall gap 4; leaf bottom to floor 4 (section 9); leaf face 96; frame visible face 18.2 hinge side; lock side dims read 18 | 2.4 | 23 (blurry, estimated); frame depth 101.6 = 34.6 + 67; leaf zone 107.6 = 35 + 72.6
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only.
